text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: There are lots of special days in life.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Birthdays, Shichi-Go-San, wedding anniversaries… All are worth celebrating, but…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Today is more wonderful than all of them put together!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Today is the day I get to race Dia in a G1 race! Today is the day we've been working toward forever!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And entering the scene to the roar of the crowd, voted the most popular Umamusume by the fans, Kitasan Black!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: I don't think there's ever been an Umamusume as beloved as her! Just look at all those huge flags being waved around the paddock in support!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And now, making her own dazzling entrance, it's the second-most popular Umamusume, Satono Diamond!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: She was born into wealth and has been in the spotlight since before her debut! Surely this gorgeous diamond will shine on the track today!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: What dramatic twists and turns are in store for us today as these two lifelong friends go head-to-head?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Twists and turns? There won't be anything like what they're expecting, even if there are any… We only got this far because we had each other.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Agreed. I'm just glad that we received so many votes from the fans.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I think the number of people who voted for me went up a little, but I only got first by a narrow margin.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Indeed. I trailed behind you very slightly, but that's how things always have been, haven't they?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: It's almost scary how fast you caught up to me! Still…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'm not going to let you surpass me, either in the polls or the race! I'm crossing the finish line first, Dia!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'm not going to accept the status quo. It's time for me to shake things up. Today's the day I overtake you and beat you to the finish!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Let's make this festival one for the ages, together!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes! At long last, our dream is about to turn into reality!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At first glance, the two of them are nothing alike. Their families, the racers they idolize, and even the year they debuted are different. However…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Their dream of running together has never changed. They've traveled along the same river together for so long, and now their dream race is finally starting!
